jobs.title: International Treasury Manager
jobs.description:
The International Treasury Manager and Analysis position will oversee and manage all international treasury related activities located in China, Mexico, Brazil, Canada, Germany, United Kingdom, Italy, and any other international entity created in the future.  This position will also oversee and strategically direct the day-to-day, tactical work related to the international treasury function which are performed by the International Treasury Staff.
- A Bachelor's degree (BA, BS) or equivalent in the Accounting, Finance, Economics or related field
- International Finance degree and MBA a plus. Master's degree preferred
- 3-5 years of Treasury experience, financial analysis and business planning
- 7+ years of general experience
- Manage all international banking functions (including AutoZone and subsidiaries within China, Mexico, Brazil, Canada, Germany, United Kingdom, Italy, any other international entity created in the future) to ensure proper cash management, liquidity, capital and related activities are employed in-country and banking functions are managed to ensure the lowest cost and service levels are property maintained
- Manage the set-up of bank accounts, bank relationships, credit card processing, armored car, and all aspects related to cost of tender acceptance related to international entities
- Manage the international capital structure of the company which includes cash forecasts, working capital management, supplier financing, dividends, external investments (over $150MM), intercompany loans, and any external debt outside the US
- Analyze and manage key global commodity risk exposure data (e.g. foreign exchange, fuel, commodities) and develop models to quantify risks on an enterprise basis
- Develop and implement commodity (including foreign exchange) hedging strategies, if necessary, and ensure that such risks are communicated throughout the organization and provide commodity forecasting for planning purposes
- Evaluate current programs and developing analytic models to evaluate hedge effectiveness, and alternative hedging strategies from both an economics and accounting perspective
- Serve as the direct liaison to Risk Management for all international insurance coverage needs, including but not limited to, insurance information requests, local country insurance requirements and placements, surety bonds, and claims analysis
- Serve as the direct liaison to Credit Card Administration (PCard, T&E Card etc) for all international credit card needs including, correspondence with card holders and card issuers, receipt of rebates, and any other cardholder related issues that may come up.
- Performs special projects as directed by management
The International Treasury Manager and Analysis position will oversee and manage all international treasury related activities located in China, Mexico, Brazil, Canada, Germany, United Kingdom, Italy, and any other international entity created in the future. This position will also oversee and strategically direct the day-to-day, tactical work related to the international treasury function which are performed by the International Treasury Staff.

jobs.title: Distribution Center Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Come be a part of an energizing culture rooted in people with a commitment to delivering WOW! customer service. If you enjoy fast-paced, physical positions that gets you up and moving, then look no further.

AutoZone is the place for you!

We offer flexible work schedules in our world class distribution centers with climate-controlled workspaces.

This key position in AutoZone’s distribution center oversees and manages the daily operation of a single shift in the distribution center responsible for accuracy, productivity, on-time delivery and safety. The Operations Manager will regularly communicate with the DC Manager regarding process improvements, goals and metrics.
- Minimum of 5 years successful experience in a distribution/warehouse experience
- Must be flexible for shift schedule
- Cross functional experience overseeing multiple areas simultaneously
- Experience operating Powered Industrial Equipment (PIE)
- Exceptional people skills with the ability to communicate effectively
- Understand the demands of a fast paced work environment involving receiving, stocking, inbound, outbound, replenishment, returns/recalls, etc.
- P&L management experience preferred.
- Bilingual preferred, Spanish and English
- Manage and assist Advisors/Supervisors in multiple departments
- Ability to motivate and work in a team environment
- Ensure that all Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are on target for the operation
- Frequently attend and/or lead pre-shift meetings in different departments to communicate and prioritize assignments, safety issues and extra tasks
- Mentor, train and develop Advisors for career progression
- Develop and share best practices across shifts
- Drive continuous improvement to safety, quality, cost and delivery
- Communicate new policies and procedures to Advisors and AutoZoners
- Maintains a safe working environment while ensuring AutoZoners are implementing those practices including PPE (Personal Protective Equipment)
- Ability to work in a Safety Sensitive environment
- Other duties as assigned
This key position in AutoZone’s distribution center oversees and manages the daily operation of a single shift in the distribution center responsible for accuracy, productivity, on-time delivery and safety.

jobs.title: Assistant Category Manager
jobs.description:
The Assistant Category Manager supports the Category Manager in developing, executing, and maintaining product category strategies that drive sales, profitability, inventory productivity, and customer value for AutoZone. This entry-level position assists with assortment planning, business analysis, pricing and promotional activities, supplier coordination, product setup, inventory monitoring, and cross-functional execution. The Assistant Category Manager gathers and interprets business information, maintains accurate category data and documentation, prepares reports and presentations, and recommends actions based on identifiable trends. Working within established strategies and processes, this position completes assigned responsibilities independently, makes decisions within a defined scope, and escalates significant risks or complex issues to the Category Manager. This role provides practical experience across the category management function and is intended to build the financial, analytical, merchandising, supplier-management, and leadership capabilities needed for future career growth.
- Bachelor’s degree in merchandising, marketing, business, finance, supply chain, data analytics, or a related field preferred.
- Three to Five years of general experience.
- Individuals with an equivalent combination of education, retail experience, internships, or relevant project experience may also be considered.
- This is an entry-level position; previous category management, merchandising, or buying experience is not required.
- Retail store, customer service, inventory, purchasing, merchandising, supplier coordination, project management, or business internship experience is preferred but not required.

- Foundational understanding of, or an interest in learning, retail financial measures such as sales, gross margin, cost, pricing, inventory, and inventory turnover.

- Ability to review information, identify basic trends, recognize inconsistencies, and communicate findings clearly.

- Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize responsibilities, maintain accurate records, and meet multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong attention to detail and demonstrated commitment to data, product, pricing, promotional, and documentation accuracy.

- Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear reports, contribute to presentations, and work professionally with internal and external partners.

- Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and build positive working relationships.
- Demonstrated curiosity, initiative, accountability, problem-solving ability, and willingness to learn new products, processes, systems, and analytical concepts.
- Ability to make sound decisions within an established scope, follow defined processes, and escalate complex or high-risk issues appropriately.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
- Foundational Excel skills, including the ability to organize data and use basic formulas; experience with pivot tables, lookup functions, or other analytical features is preferred but not required.
- Experience using retail, inventory, purchasing, enterprise resource planning, reporting, or merchandising systems is helpful but not required.
- Ability to adapt to changing priorities, accept coaching and feedback, and manage assigned responsibilities with appropriate guidance.
The Assistant Category Manager is expected to learn AutoZone's merchandising processes, systems, suppliers, and category management fundamentals while providing analytical, operational, and administrative support to the Category Manager. At time of hire the key responsibilities are as follows:
Category Administration & Execution
- Maintain product, pricing, supplier, assortment, and promotional data within merchandising systems.
- Complete item setup, SKU maintenance, and product information updates.
- Maintain assortment files, category documentation, calendars, trackers, and project records.
- Coordinate product samples, meeting materials, and presentation support.
- Assist with advertising, promotional, and category execution tasks to ensure accuracy and timeliness.

Reporting & Analysis
- Prepare routine sales, margin, inventory, pricing, and promotional reports.
- Monitor category performance and identify basic trends or variances.
- Compile seasonal, monthly, and quarterly business recaps.
- Gather market, competitive, and product information for category reviews.
- Validate data accuracy and help identify reporting discrepancies.

Supplier & Product Support
- Coordinate supplier communications regarding item information, images, specifications, costs, samples, and product updates.
- Track supplier shipments and communicate delivery issues to internal stakeholders.
- Support supplier meeting preparation and maintain follow-up documentation.
- Assist in collecting information for assortment and product decisions.

Cross-Functional Partnership
- Coordinate with inventory management, pricing, supply chain, marketing, digital, and store operations teams to support execution of approved category plans.
- Communicate approved assortment, pricing, promotional, and product updates to stakeholders.
- Participate in cross-functional meetings and project activities.

Professional Development
- Learn category financial concepts including sales, margin, inventory productivity, and inventory turns.
- Develop a working knowledge of AutoZone product categories, customers, competitors, and suppliers.
- Demonstrate curiosity, continuous learning, and increasing independence in assigned work.

After demonstrating proficiency in foundational responsibilities, the Assistant Category Manager assumes greater ownership of category activities and begins contributing to category planning and decision-making. Expanded responsibilities are as follows:
Category Planning & Strategy Support
- Recommend assortment additions, deletions, and product changes based on sales performance and market trends.
- Contribute to seasonal assortment reviews and product line evaluations.
- Support development of pricing and promotional recommendations.
- Assist in identifying category growth opportunities and emerging trends.
- Prepare business cases and recommendations for Category Manager review.

Advanced Analysis & Business Insights
- Conduct deeper analysis of sales, margin, inventory, supplier, and customer-performance data.
- Identify root causes of business performance issues and recommend corrective actions.
- Monitor category performance against financial plans and key business objectives.
- Evaluate promotional effectiveness and product performance trends.

Supplier Relationship Management
- Serve as a day-to-day contact for assigned suppliers.
- Participate in supplier reviews and product line presentations.
- Assist with supplier negotiations by gathering cost, pricing, competitive, and performance information.
- Support supplier performance tracking and issue resolution efforts.

Project & Process Ownership
- Lead selected category projects with guidance from the Category Manager.
- Manage implementation of category-specific initiatives, product launches, or assortment updates.
- Recommend process improvements that increase efficiency, accuracy, or speed to market.
- Train and support new team members on established tools and processes.

Cross-Functional Leadership
- Coordinate execution activities across multiple business functions.
- Lead meetings related to assigned projects, initiatives, or category workstreams.
- Influence stakeholders through data-based recommendations and business insights.
- Represent the category team in selected cross-functional projects and initiatives.

Category Ownership Development
- Independently manage selected product lines, vendors, or subcategories under Category Manager supervision.
- Support annual planning activities, forecasts, budget preparation, and inventory planning.
- Develop recommendations regarding assortment strategy, inventory actions, pricing opportunities, and promotional activities.
- Demonstrate readiness for future progression into a Category Manager role through increasingly independent ownership of category responsibilities.
The Assistant Category Manager supports the Category Manager in developing, executing, and maintaining product category strategies that drive sales, profitability, inventory productivity, and customer value for AutoZone.

jobs.title: MGR,GLOBAL SOURCING-PRIV LABEL
jobs.description:
AutoZone is looking for a motivated organized individual to fill the Global Sourcing Manager – Private Label  position. This role is responsible for strategically leading the Product management process by supporting the merchandising team and establishing Product standards. Duties include management of the Product Requirements Document (PRD), Project Management for PRD and Compliance support. In addition, the role will be in charge of process documentation, assigned by the manager. The ideal candidate will be able to strategically manage existing systems while working to monitor and continuously improve their effectiveness. This role is to work closely with internal and industry resources to identify and monitor product laws affecting AutoZone’s products then develop appropriate programs and training.
- 3 to 5 years work experience in a corporate setting
- 4 year degree  - Engineering (Automotive/Mechanical or Industrial), Quality or Management preferred
- Dynamic personality who can manage many projects at once and thrive in a fast paced environment
- Relationship builder, demonstrating an ability to listen and respond to a wide variety of questions
- Ability to present product presentations with knowledge and confidence to explain each item and its distinguishing features
- Strong understanding of overseas sourcing and various manufacturing methods
- Analytical skills and statistical analysis proficiency
- Superior verbal & written communication skills
- Proficiency in Word, PowerPoint, Excel, MS Project & MS Share Point
- Strong understanding of automotive products with automotive industry experience
- Understanding of retail organization product management system
- Understanding of Quality Management Systems such as ISO9001 or TS16949
- Ability to work across multiple functions and lines of business
- Ability to travel domestic and internationally per business needs
- Experience as a leader of project teams
- PMP or equivalent certified
- ASE certified preferred
- Retail/business experience – automotive experience a plus
- Basic statistical analysis ability
- Provide strategic direction for AutoZone’s Product Management program. The job is to manage the projects with teams around the world to ensure establishing standards/brands and documentation.
- Determine the budgetary requirements needed to manage the program.
- Collaborate with merchandising on changes to product requirements from attributes perspective
- Develop standard product requirements documents for key categories for manufactures to review and use to submit quotes
- Plan and track the development schedule of all projects to ensure timely completion following the predetermined product requirements calendar
- Work with international teams and factories to produce products that meet customer requirements and generate internal cost-savings requirements.
- Be the liaison between countries to answer product questions and provide innovative suggestions for any potential roadblocks in production

- Collaborate with testing labs on changes to product requirements from test standards perspective
- Provide technical knowledge to achieve resolution of quality issues through knowledge of various manufacturing methods
- Evaluate development samples against requirements accuracy and functionality
- Administrator role for  software tools to manage and Product Information Warehouse/PRD, and ensure factories are using correct source files for product requirements.
- Limited international and domestic travel required

jobs.title: Manager, Marketing Research - Customer & Competitive Insights
jobs.description:
AutoZone is hiring a Marketing Research Manager, Customer and Competitive Insights, to understand why customers choose us, why they choose someone else, and what we should do differently, across both B2C and B2B verticals. You’ll lead research with DIY consumers and professional repair shops: brand-health tracking, competitive intelligence, custom studies, customer-journey and loyalty research, and social listening. This is a senior individual-contributor role in Marketing Analytics & Insights, reporting to the Sr. Manager of Marketing Analytics & Insights. You’ll design studies, analyze the data, manage research partners, and present your conclusions to senior leaders.
You’ll have responsibility for established research programs and room to shape what we study next. Working within an analytics team means you can investigate both what customers say and what they buy. The work can inform how we respond to competitors, which services and loyalty benefits we emphasize, how we communicate value, and where we improve the shopping experience. Custom studies and competitive reviews will be prioritized with your manager around specific business decisions.
- Education: A master’s degree or PhD in a relevant field.
- Research Experience: Five or more years in market research, customer insights, or research consulting, with ownership of studies from design through final recommendations. Client-side or agency experience is relevant, with B2B and B2C experience preferred. Experience with brand tracking, customer-journey research, social listening, or syndicated market data is especially valuable
- Research and Quantitative Methods: Strong questionnaire design, sampling, weighting, and quantitative analysis skills, along with experience using qualitative research. You should be able to identify a weak sample, a leading question, or a conclusion that goes beyond the evidence.
- Communicate for Impact: You can turn a substantial body of research into a focused report, make useful charts, and explain your conclusions to people who do not share your technical background. You can challenge an assumption constructively and recommend a course of action when the evidence is incomplete.
- Brand Health Tracking: Lead our ongoing DIY and Commercial tracking programs, from questionnaire and sample design through analysis and reporting. Track awareness, consideration, preference, satisfaction, and perceptions of value, quality, and service. Investigate changes by customer or shop segment, check whether they reflect meaningful shifts, and explain what they mean for AutoZone.
- Competitive Intelligence and Social Listening: Combine customer research, syndicated competitive advertising data, and social listening to assess competitors’ positioning, creative, messaging, promotions, and digital experiences. Review relevant sponsorships, partnerships, and local marketing as part of focused competitive studies. Investigate emerging competitors and changes in customer needs, shopping and search behavior, and sentiment. Identify which customer groups are affected and where AutoZone should respond or investigate further. Distinguish observed competitive activity from evidence of customer response.
- Research Design and Recommendations: Work with business partners to define the question and the decision it needs to inform. Design surveys, interviews, and mixed-method studies on customer journeys, shopping experiences, brand positioning, creative and messages, price and value perceptions, and services. Write questionnaires and discussion guides, choose the sample and method, oversee fieldwork, and carry the analysis through to a recommendation.
- Loyalty and Customer Communications Research: Compare loyalty programs, rewards structures, member benefits, and offers across key competitors and selected retailers. Study what customers understand and value, barriers to joining or redeeming rewards, and reasons for staying engaged or leaving. Review selected email, SMS, and push communications across onboarding, promotional, retention, and win-back journeys. Test benefits, offers, and messages with customers and recommend improvements to Loyalty and CRM teams.
- Advance Research Analytics: Work directly with respondent-level data, using statistical testing, regression, driver analysis, segmentation, and open-text analysis as appropriate. Work with our analytics team to compare research findings with customer, transaction, and syndicated market data. Use code and AI-assisted development tools to build repeatable processes for cleaning data, checking quality, analyzing responses, and producing charts.
- Insight Synthesis for Stakeholders: Synthesize syndicated competitive advertising data on media spend, channel activity, and creative with findings from brand-health tracking, advertising recall, social listening, and loyalty research. Assess how competitors’ creative, messaging, promotions, sponsorships, partnerships, and local marketing relate to customer perceptions, consideration, and preference. Present clear findings to leaders in Marketing, Digital Experience, Merchandising, Store Operations, and Commercial, with recommendations for Brand, Creative, Media, and Loyalty teams. Explain what the evidence supports, what remains uncertain, and where further research or testing is needed. Estimate the size of an opportunity where the data allows, and help teams decide what to test and how to evaluate the result.
- Vendor Management and Methodology Standards: Manage agency briefs, methods, budgets, timelines, and deliverables. Review the underlying work and pursue questions that need more analysis. Improve our questionnaires and recurring reports, document methods so others can reproduce the work, and help analysts develop their research skills.

jobs.title: Senior Category Manager
jobs.description:
The Senior Category Manager is responsible for leading the strategy, financial performance, assortment development, pricing, vendor partnerships, inventory management, and overall business results for highly complex, high-volume product categories or groups of related subcategories. This position develops and implements category buying, pricing, promotional, and marketing strategies while ensuring category performance aligns with AutoZone's customer, sales, profitability, and market-share objectives. The Senior Category Manager serves as a senior merchandising leader, providing guidance to Category Managers and supporting the development of merchandising talent while partnering closely with Directors of Category Management on strategic initiatives and long-term category planning. The role requires advanced merchandising expertise, strong financial acumen, vendor negotiation capabilities, and the ability to manage large-scale business opportunities and risks.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required .
- Five to seven years experience, preferably in a retail operations environment .
- Prior experience in merchandising, purchasing and manufacturing a plus. Strong financial acumen and communication skills .
- Strong retail foundation, vendor management and analytical skills
Category Strategy & Business Ownership
•    Lead the development and execution of long-term category strategies for highly complex, high-volume categories or multiple interconnected subcategories.
•    Develop and implement category buying, pricing, marketing, and promotional philosophies that support AutoZone's strategic and financial objectives.
•    Identify growth opportunities through assortment expansion, product innovation, customer insights, market trends, emerging technologies, and changing industry conditions.
•    Evaluate category performance and establish strategic actions that improve market share, customer penetration, profitability, and category productivity.
•    Participate in senior merchandising team decisions and help influence broader merchandising strategies across multiple categories.

Financial Management & Category Performance
•    Own the sales, margin, profitability, inventory productivity, and market performance of assigned categories.
•    Develop annual operating plans, sales forecasts, inventory strategies, promotional plans, and financial targets for assigned categories.
•    Analyze sales, gross profit, inventory, vendor, customer, and market data to ensure assigned categories achieve established financial objectives.
•    Drive category performance through strategic pricing, assortment optimization, inventory management, vendor partnerships, and promotional activities.
•    Identify risks and opportunities early and implement corrective actions to maximize results and minimize business disruption.

Vendor Strategy and Negotiations
•    Develop and maintain strategic vendor relationships that support category growth, innovation, profitability, and operational excellence.
•    Lead complex vendor negotiations involving cost structures, pricing, contracts, funding programs, product exclusivity, service expectations, and performance requirements.
•    Evaluate vendor performance and drive continuous improvement in product availability, service levels, inventory flow, quality, and profitability.
•    Collaborate with vendors to identify innovation opportunities, develop new products, improve packaging, and enhance category performance.
•    Select and develop vendor partnerships that support long-term category strategies and customer needs.

Assortment, Pricing and Product Lifecycle Management
•    Ensure the right products are positioned in the right stores at the right price through data-driven assortment and pricing strategies.
•    Lead category assortment reviews and make final recommendations on product additions, deletions, replacements, and lifecycle management decisions.
•    Monitor competitive activity, customer demand, and category trends to continuously improve assortment productivity and relevance.
•    Oversee testing and evaluation of new products and category innovations to support future growth.

Cross-Functional Leadership and Execution
•    Lead cross-functional collaboration with inventory management, supply chain, pricing, marketing, digital, finance, store operations, and commercial business teams to execute category strategies.
•    Direct the execution of category initiatives, large-scale product launches, assortment transitions, vendor changes, and promotional programs.
•    Resolve complex supply chain, inventory, product availability, quality, and operational issues impacting category performance.
•    Lead high-impact projects that improve merchandising effectiveness, operational efficiency, reporting capabilities, and customer experience.

Leadership and Talent Development
•    Provide mentorship, coaching, and development support to Category Managers, Senior Assistant Category Managers, Assistant Category Managers, and other merchandising team members.
•    Share merchandising best practices, category expertise, and business insights across the merchandising organization.
•    Lead through influence and serve as a senior resource for category-related decision making, problem solving, and strategy execution.
•    Support succession planning efforts by developing future merchandising leaders and strengthening organizational capability.
Strategic Innovation and Continuous Improvement
•    Leverage customer insights, market research, industry developments, and vendor expertise to anticipate emerging trends and business opportunities.
•    Champion innovation and continuous improvement initiatives that improve category performance, customer experience, and business efficiency.
•    Recommend and implement enhancements to merchandising processes, systems, reporting, and business practices.
•    Drive adoption of new tools, processes, and merchandising capabilities across supported categories and teams.

jobs.title: Assistant Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Description
The Direct Marketing Assistant Manager focused on Campaign Delivery & Operations serves as the operational execution lead within Direct Marketing and is responsible for delivering enterprise direct marketing campaigns across email, SMS, push notifications, direct mail, and future customer engagement channels.

This role owns the end-to-end campaign execution process, including campaign production, deployment management, quality assurance, workflow optimization, and operational governance. The position ensures customer communications are delivered accurately, efficiently, and on schedule while continuously improving operational processes, documentation, and team capabilities.

This role directly supervises the Direct Marketing Coordinator and serves as the primary operational partner to the Direct Marketing Associate Manager and the Direct Marketing Assistant Manager focused on Customer Intelligence & Personalization.

Responsibilities

Campaign Delivery
•    Lead end-to-end execution of enterprise direct marketing campaigns across all customer communication channels.
•    Manage campaign production schedules and deployment timelines.
•    Coordinate campaign setup and execution activities within marketing platforms.
•    Ensure all campaigns are executed accurately and according to approved requirements.
•    Manage execution of promotional, lifecycle, triggered, and always-on communications.
•    Monitor campaign launches and resolves execution issues as necessary.
•    Coordinate execution of testing initiatives and campaign experiments.
•    Support implementation of new channels and communication capabilities.

Marketing Operations
•    Establish and maintain enterprise campaign production standards.
•    Develop and manage operational workflows and processes.
•    Create and maintain campaign execution documentation and standard operating procedures.
•    Define service-level expectations for campaign delivery.
•    Coordinate campaign resources and workload planning.
•    Maintain campaign calendars and deployment schedules.
•    Partner with Marketing Technology on platform enhancements and operational requirements.
•    Support vendor relationships and operational partnerships.
Quality Assurance & Compliance
•    Own enterprise quality assurance standards and processes.
•    Develop and maintain deployment readiness checklists.
•    Validate links, tracking parameters, offers, dynamic content, and personalization.
•    Review campaigns for accuracy and adherence to approved requirements.
•    Coordinate rendering and functionality testing across channels and devices.
•    Monitor compliance with operational standards and governance requirements.
•    Document and resolve operational issues and defects.
•    Conduct post-launch validation and issue management.

Project & Resource Management
•    Coordinate campaign execution across multiple concurrent projects.
•    Prioritize workloads and allocate resources effectively.
•    Manage campaign intake from an operational perspective.
•    Facilitate operational meetings and status updates.
•    Identify risks to timelines and deliverables and develop mitigation plans.
•    Coordinate dependencies across business partners and vendors.
•    Monitor production capacity and recommend resource adjustments.

Operational Excellence
•    Continuously improve operational processes and workflows.
•    Identify opportunities for automation and increased efficiency.
•    Develop reusable templates and standardized processes.
•    Reduce campaign cycle times and operational errors.
•    Establish operational metrics and reporting.
•    Support implementation of new technologies and capabilities.
•    Drive operational scalability and organizational readiness.

Team Leadership
•    Directly supervise the Direct Marketing Coordinator.
•    Provide coaching, training, and professional development.
•    Establish clear goals and performance expectations.
•    Manage workload planning and prioritization.
•    Develop backup coverage and knowledge-sharing practices.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
•    Support onboarding and training of future team members.

Qualifications
•    Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
•    3+ years of direct marketing, campaign operations, marketing operations, CRM, or related experience.
•    1+ years of project leadership or people management experience preferred.
•    Experience managing large-scale marketing campaigns and operational workflows.
•    Strong project management and organizational skills.
•    Strong written and verbal communication skills.
•    Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
•    Strong attention to detail and process discipline.
•    Experience collaborating across cross-functional teams.

jobs.title: Assistant Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
An Assistant Marketing Manager, Media understands how to develop and execute a marketing plan with a customer first approach, how media and creative work together, and the complexities of an evolving media landscape.
The person in this role is responsible for the strategy, execution, measurement, and optimization of paid social campaigns. This includes direct platform management, ownership of tagging and measurement frameworks, collaboration with agency and platform partners, and close partnership with organic social, brand, and creative teams to ensure campaign effectiveness and alignment.
This position also plays a key role in strengthening media operations through the development of workflows, quality assurance processes, documentation, and reporting tools that support efficient campaign execution and ongoing business performance analysis.
The person in this role assists the Senior Marketing Manager with a variety of projects, including media performance reporting, competitive media analyses, marketing mix modeling support, budget reporting, category sales reporting, and test-and-learn initiatives. Developing strong partnerships with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Ecommerce, Merchandising, Store Operations, IT, and agency partners is essential.
This person will consistently seek opportunities to improve processes, identify and execute innovative media tests, stay current on emerging platform capabilities and AI-driven media buying solutions, and coordinate activities with internal stakeholders, media vendors, and agency partners.
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing or related field
2-4 years’ experience in Marketing (any discipline including but not limited to Advertising, Design, Content, CRM/Loyalty, Insights, Media, Social, Ecommerce) or Other related field
Project management certification a plus
Ability to multi-task in high paced retail business environment
Highly motivated with ability to meet tight deadlines
Strong communication skills with all levels of employees, as well as outside contacts
Ability to solve complex problems efficiently and creatively
An ability to prepare and interpret workflows, schedules, and step-by-step action plans
Strong working knowledge of Adobe Workfront or other workflow management tool a plus
- Leads paid social campaign execution, including campaign setup, trafficking, quality assurance, budget pacing, optimization, and performance monitoring
- Owns tagging and measurement strategy for paid social campaigns, including pixel implementation, Conversions API requirements, campaign taxonomy, and signal quality monitoring
- Partners with IT teams and external vendors to ensure accurate tracking, reporting, and campaign measurement implementation
- Develops and maintains media operations documentation, including workflows, quality assurance checklists, trafficking processes, and invoice reconciliation procedures
- Designs and executes test-and-learn initiatives, including creative testing, incrementality studies, holdout testing, and evaluation of new platform capabilities
- Oversees performance reporting and provides data-driven recommendations to improve campaign effectiveness and business results
- Prepares and distributes reports, including competitive media analyses, media category support summaries, and sales and service heat maps
- Supports marketing mix modeling initiatives, budget reporting, and monthly category sales reporting
- Coordinates integration between paid and organic social media efforts and contributes media recommendations for creative development and campaign planning
- Ability to manage multiple projects by tracking deadlines and collecting and organizing information
- Strong project management skills to enable multiple projects running on time and on budget
- Ability to interact with multiple agency and platform partners on projects and provide feedback on their performance
An Assistant Marketing Manager, Media is responsible for executing and optimizing paid social media strategies that support business objectives and drive customer engagement. This role manages campaign performance, measurement, and reporting while partnering closely with creative, brand, agency, and platform teams to ensure effective and efficient media execution. The position also supports broader media operations through process improvement, performance analysis, budget management, and cross-functional collaboration, while continuously identifying innovative opportunities to enhance campaign effectiveness and business results.

jobs.title: Category Manager
jobs.description:
The Category Manager is responsible for developing and executing the strategy for assigned product categories to drive sales, profitability, inventory productivity, market share, and customer value. This position manages category financial performance, product assortment, pricing, promotions, vendor relationships, and inventory decisions while using customer, competitive, market, and business insights to identify opportunities and mitigate risk. The Category Manager works cross-functionally with inventory management, supply chain, marketing, digital, store operations, finance, and other business partners to ensure category plans are effectively developed and executed across channels. This role may also provide management, coaching, and development to direct report(s) supporting the assigned categories.
What We’re Looking For:
- Demonstrated capability to lead, communicate, and present category initiatives effectively
- Comprehensive knowledge of merchandising retail math/financial skills
- Organized, detail-oriented, and strong time management skills
- Proficient in Microsoft Office (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)

You’ll Go The Extra Mile If You Have:
- 3-5 years of retail experience, preferably in the automotive industry
Category Strategy & Assortment Management
•    Develop and execute short-term and long-term category strategies that align with company objectives, customer needs, brand direction, and merchandising priorities.
•    Create and maintain category assortments that optimize customer choice, sales performance, profitability, inventory productivity, and market share.
•    Evaluate customer insights, industry developments, product trends, and competitive activity to identify assortment gaps, growth opportunities, and strategic initiatives.
•    Develop category pricing, promotional, and product placement strategies that support financial objectives and enhance the customer experience.
•    Lead category line reviews and assortment planning activities to ensure alignment with business objectives and customer demand.
•    Identify and execute category expansion, localization, digital merchandising, product innovation, and other growth opportunities.

Financial Management & Business Performance
•    Own the financial performance of assigned categories, including sales, gross margin, profitability, inventory productivity, inventory turns, and budget attainment.
•    Develop annual and seasonal sales, margin, inventory, and assortment plans in partnership with inventory management and finance teams.
•    Monitor category performance and adjust assortment, pricing, promotional, and inventory strategies to maximize results and mitigate risk.
•    Analyze category performance using sales, profit, inventory, customer, vendor, and market data to identify trends and support strategic decision-making.
•    Present business reviews, category performance updates, forecasts, and strategic recommendations to leadership.

Vendor Relationship Management
•    Develop and maintain strategic vendor relationships that support category growth, innovation, profitability, operational performance, and long-term business objectives.
•    Lead negotiations related to product costs, pricing, contract terms, service expectations, vendor funding, product quality, and performance metrics.
•    Evaluate vendor performance and implement actions to improve service, product availability, profitability, and execution.
•    Collaborate with vendors on product development, assortment opportunities, promotional plans, packaging improvements, and new business initiatives.
•    Resolve vendor-related issues involving inventory, product quality, pricing, packaging, logistics, and customer experience.

Inventory, Pricing and Promotional Management
•    Partner with inventory management and supply chain teams to develop inventory plans, demand forecasts, replenishment strategies, and receipt schedules.
•    Monitor inventory performance and execute corrective actions to optimize stock levels and improve inventory productivity.
•    Approve pricing recommendations, promotional strategies, and markdown activities that support profitability and customer value objectives.
•    Evaluate promotional effectiveness and implement adjustments based on performance results and changing business conditions.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Execution
•    Collaborate with marketing, digital, pricing, inventory management, supply chain, finance, visual merchandising, and store operations teams to execute category strategies.
•    Lead the cross-functional execution of category initiatives, product launches, assortment transitions, and promotional events.
•    Ensure category plans are implemented accurately and effectively across all channels and customer touchpoints.
•    Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance merchandising effectiveness, operational efficiency, reporting accuracy, and customer experience.

Team Leadership & Talent Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop Assistant Category Managers, Senior Assistant Category Managers, and other supporting team members.
•    Establish priorities, communicate expectations, provide performance feedback, and support professional development.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and business ownership within the merchandising team.
•    Support succession planning by preparing team members for increasing responsibility and future leadership opportunities.

Operational Excellence and Governance
•    Ensure the accurate execution of category processes, including item maintenance, promotional setup, product launches, vendor documentation, and reporting activities.
•    Maintain compliance with company policies, merchandising standards, vendor agreements, and operational requirements.
•    Identify and implement opportunities to improve systems, workflows, reporting, controls, and category management processes.
•    Exercise sound business judgment and make decisions that balance customer needs, financial objectives, vendor partnerships, and operational requirements.

This position manages category financial performance, product assortment, pricing, promotions, vendor relationships, and inventory decisions while using customer, competitive, market, and business insights to identify opportunities and mitigate risk.

jobs.title: Territory Sales Manager
jobs.description:
AutoZone’s Commercial Sales team is dedicated to delivering exceptional service and driving growth across our network of commercial accounts. This team builds lasting relationships with automotive professionals, shop owners, and commercial customers by providing reliable parts delivery, expert support, and personalized service that sets AutoZone apart.

As a Territory Sales Manager, you’ll oversee the commercial performance of multiple stores, lead and motivate sales teams, and ensure that every commercial customer receives WOW! Customer Service. You’ll develop market strategies, manage key accounts, and partner with operations to drive profitability and customer satisfaction. This role requires strong leadership, sales acumen, and a commitment to excellence.
What We’re Looking For
- Minimum 3 years of outside sales experience (automotive industry preferred)
- Experience managing or leading teams (direct or indirect)
- Strong communication, negotiation, and organizational skills
- Ability to travel at least 50% of the time, including overnight travel
- Understanding of sales metrics, customer development plans, and profitability analysis
- Proven integrity, passion, and drive for success

You’ll Go the Extra Mile If You Have

- Automotive industry experience or technical product knowledge
- Familiarity with commercial account management tools or CRM systems
- Experience developing and executing territory growth strategies
- Ability to coach and mentor sales teams to peak performance
- Strong customer service orientation and problem-solving skills
Customer Relationship Management
- Build loyalty and trust with current and prospective commercial customers
- Visit accounts regularly to ensure service quality and timely deliveries
- Address customer concerns and turn complaints into compliments

Sales Leadership & Strategy
- Drive sales growth and profitability across the territory
- Motivate and lead Commercial Managers and Mobile Sales Reps to achieve targets
- Develop market analysis and action plans for commercial accounts
- Identify new business opportunities through face-to-face and phone outreach

Operational Excellence
- Partner with Operations to ensure smooth customer experience from order to fulfillment
- Ensure stocking programs are maintained weekly per policy
- Monitor store performance and provide feedback to improve service and productivity

Team Management & Safety
- Lead and coach Commercial AutoZoners to deliver WOW! Customer Service
- Ensure compliance with company policies, loss prevention, and safe driving procedures
- Maintain a safe working environment and enforce PPE usage
- Properly maintain company vehicle and report maintenance issues

Reporting & Compliance
- Analyze sales reports and take appropriate action
- Understand and apply P&L and gross profit principles
- Follow accident procedures and ensure driver status compliance
AutoZone is seeking a Territory Sales Manager (TSM) to lead commercial sales efforts within a designated territory. This role is responsible for maintaining and growing relationships with existing commercial customers, acquiring new accounts, and ensuring a seamless customer experience from sales call to delivery. The ideal candidate is a driven sales professional with leadership experience and a passion for exceeding customer expectations.

jobs.title: Commercial Sales Manager
jobs.description:
The Commercial Sales Team at AutoZone plays a pivotal role in driving growth across our professional customer base. Focused on delivering quality parts, reliable service, and dedicated support, this team connects AutoZone with mechanics, garages, fleet operators, and automotive professionals nationwide.

As the Commercial Sales Manager at AutoZone, you'll be the driving force behind our business to business (B2B) growth strategy, championing customer relationships and leading a high-performing team. This role blends your passion for automotive parts with your sales expertise, empowering you to build lasting partnerships with commercial accounts and deliver exceptional service that truly WOWs. Success in this role means leveraging clear communication, collaborative leadership, and a sharp eye for performance metrics to fuel consistent, profitable growth.
What We Are Looking For:
- Basic automotive parts knowledge.
- Leadership skills with strong communication, decision-making, and selling abilities.
- Physical capability to lift, load, and deliver merchandise.
- Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as required.

You’ll Go The Extra Mile If You Have:

- Exceptional Communication: Strong people skills and effective communication in both Spanish and English.
- Achieve Sales Goals & Metrics – Drive commercial sales growth, maintain strong account relationships, and hit key performance targets through face-to-face and phone communication.
- Customer Relationships & Communication – Serve as the primary contact for our commercial customers, ensuring proactive engagement and clear communication.
- Leadership & Team Development – Train and develop drivers, commercial specialists, and team members while fostering a collaborative, results-driven culture.
- Structure & Process Orientation – Plan efficient delivery routes, manage drivers, ensure timely product distribution, and uphold accurate documentation.
- Expert Automotive Knowledge – Act as a consultative partner, providing research-based recommendations and expert advice to meet customer needs.
- Account Management – Oversee billing, records, returns, and reconciliation of commercial accounts while ensuring accuracy.
- Safety & Compliance – Maintain a safe work environment, enforce PPE usage, and follow fleet safety protocols.
- Vehicle Maintenance – Ensure delivery vehicles are properly maintained and report any issues promptly.
AutoZone's Commercial Sales Manager leads B2B growth by building lasting partnerships with commercial clients and delivering WOW! customer service. This role combines automotive expertise, sales performance, and team development to drive measurable results and deepen client relationships.

AutoZone’s Store Management team drives store performance, fosters a productive team, and ensures exceptional customer service. Managers and MITs play a key leadership role, expected to Live The Pledge and deliver WOW! Customer Service while executing store operations with excellence. Under the Store Manager’s guidance, MITs lead by example, demonstrating initiative and strong leadership. Through operational oversight and team development, store management supports AutoZone’s mission of providing trusted automotive solutions.

As a Parts Sales Manager, where you'll play a key role in driving sales performance, fostering a high-performing team, and ensuring an exceptional WOW! Customer Service experience. Join a vibrant team dedicated to reaching goals, honing leadership abilities, and fostering career growth in the automotive retail field.  AutoZone provides an ideal platform to advance your career in an essential industry that supports the driving community.
What We’re Looking For
- Leadership: Demonstrates integrity, decision-making skills, and strong leadership abilities.
- Flexible Schedule: Full-time flexible schedule availability, including mornings, nights, weekends, and overtime as needed.

You’ll Go The Extra Mile If You Have
- Exceptional Communication: Strong people skills and effective communication in both Spanish and English.
- Automotive Retail: Previous experience in automotive retail
- Certifications:  Automotive Service Excellence (ASE) Certification
- Leadership – Assist the Store Manager in supervising, training, and developing high-performing employees, fostering a motivated and engaged team.
- Communication – Maintain clear, effective interactions with both customers and employees, ensuring smooth store operations and positive experiences.
- Metrics Mindedness – Monitor sales goals, inventory accuracy, and performance standards to drive business success.
- Process Orientation – Follow structured store procedures, manage inventory, oversee cash handling, control shrink and ensure operational efficiency.
- Teamwork – Work collaboratively with store staff and commercial department leaders to maintain seamless operations and customer service excellence.
- Parts Sales & Inventory Management – Lead efforts to exceed sales targets, optimize inventory levels, and ensure timely returns processing and merchandising.
- Safety & Compliance – Enforce PPE use, promote risk management practices, and uphold company safety standards.
- Commercial Account Support – Assist in managing commercial and hub departments to support timely deliveries and customer needs.
- Problem Solving – Resolve customer concerns and store operational issues swiftly, always upholding company policies.
AutoZone’s Parts Sales Manager drives sales performance, fosters a high-performing team, and ensures WOW! Customer Service at every interaction. This leadership role provides opportunities to develop management skills, support commercial operations, and contribute to a thriving retail environment in the automotive industry.

jobs.title: REGIONAL HR MANAGER
Real Estate Development Manager
jobs.description:
Position Summary: AutoZone's Real Estate Manager identifies and evaluates building sites, conducting due diligence to assess risks and ensure viability. They maximize financial returns by analyzing property income, expenses, and making strategic decisions on leasing, purchasing, and improvements. This role involves property visits, tenant interactions, and oversight of property management teams.
What We’re Looking For: - Minimum 5 years of real estate experience
- Project management experience
- Ability to travel up to 50%

You’ll Go The Extra Mile If You Have:

- Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required
- Strong negotiation skills

-
- AutoZone's Real Estate Development Manager identifies building sites, reviews all due diligence reports and supporting information to determine the suitability and viability of specific locations and evaluate and communicate risk.
- Seeks to maximize financial returns on the organization's real estate assets.
- Analyzes individual property income and expenses and makes data driven decisions related to leasing or purchasing, financing, and capital improvements.
- Performs due diligence in advance of property acquisition.
- Visits properties, meets with tenants, and oversees the work of property managers or maintenance staff.
Join AutoZone as a Real Estate Manager! Are you ready to be a key player in AutoZone’s growth and success? You will identify and deliver top-tier sites to our Approval Committee, keeping new store schedules on track. Partner across teams to ensure deals are precise, effective, and aligned with our standards. Drive success with integrity, professionalism, and a passion for excellence. Join us and make a real impact!
